findings.problem: vamos + infinitivo is the nós form of the excluded pattern ir + infinitivo ('vamos comer' is also 'we're going to eat'), so it is the same pattern in another inflection.
findings.fix: Cut it; fill from the next item in line.

findings.problem: por has several unrelated jobs at this level (through, by, per, for a reason); the list job names all of them.
findings.fix: Tie the entry to one job: 'for' as the reason or exchange (obrigado por…, por dia).

findings.problem: Two unrelated jobs (suddenly / maybe) in one entry.
findings.fix: Tie it to the Brazilian 'maybe' job, which is the trap; 'suddenly' goes in discussion.
